statement.p: Contestants A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and I are in a 10K race.
(a) How many different ways can a race with 8 runners be completed? (Assume there is no tie.)
(b) In how many ways can G finish first and D finish second?
(c) What is the probability that G finishes first and D finishes second? Give the probability as a fraction or a decimal rounded to four decimal places.
